item.title: Raffler (1.0.1)
item.description:
Version: 1.0.1
Author: Simbo
Category: RolePlay & Music
Updated: 2025-05-20 19:49 UTC
Downloads: 4,083
File: RafflerV1.0.1.zip (41.2 KB)

A very basic and limited plugin that allows you to hold an ingame "Raffle" at roleplay social events like parties.

Simply add player names to a list and click a button to randomly pick a winner. And thats it Its up to you to hand out prizes separately.

Note that as well as players being added manually to a draw it is also possible for them to be added automatically simply by saying a specific phrase.

item.title: Songbook (0.93)
item.description:
Version: 0.93
Author: Chiran
Category: RolePlay & Music
Updated: 2021-04-06 16:26 UTC
Downloads: 311,386
File: Songbook-0.93.zip (129.0 KB)

Overview

Songbook is a plugin for browsing your abc song files and playing them with a click of a button. The plugin consists of two parts an ingame plugin which displays the song library and an external windows program that generates a list of your abc song files in a format that the plugin can read. The external program is realized as a HTA file VBScript so that its fairly easy to check for safety.

Features


Browse all your abc files ingame
Toggle music mode
Select and play a song just by clicking with your mouse

Poetical is a plugin designed to store the words of your favourite poems and songs and allows you to recite them a line at a time using a single button press.

Ability to "tag" poems and then to filter the poem list by a tag
